subject: Procurement route decision + SOC 2 / DPA evidence needed for Acme Retail
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Lewis <susan.lewis@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-01T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Procurement route decision + SOC 2 / DPA evidence needed for Acme Retail

Hi Susan — thanks for the time today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can get Acme over the finish line on onboarding.

Call highlights (short):
- Technical fit: Acme confirmed Redwood latency and embedding accuracy look good for the merchandising recommender POC.
- Security ask: SOC 2 Type II report + executed DPA required for vendor onboarding.
- Procurement preference: Finance mentioned they prefer a PO-based flow, but marketplace (AWS Marketplace) would speed procurement for product teams.

Proposed next steps (owner / ETA):
1) Attach SOC 2 and DPA draft for legal review — action: Marissa (today) — sending in separate email thread with attachments.
2) Confirm commercial path: PO vs card vs marketplace — action: Mark (Acme procurement) to advise which route triggers vendor onboarding (by 2027-02-03).
3) Security questionnaire: If Acme needs an encrypted-at-rest KMS diagram and retention policy, send the short security packet — action: Ben (security liaison) — 2027-02-02.
4) Mutual action plan / timeline for PO issuance and kickoff — action: Priyom (commercial) to draft MAP once procurement route confirmed — 2027-02-04.

Questions for you: Is Acme willing to accept our standard DPA redlines, or should we expect legal negotiation? Also, if procurement insists on PO, does onboarding require an SOC2 attestation upload to a vendor portal (some customers ask for that)?

Attachments: none in this message — will follow with the SOC2 + DPA stubs.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment stub will follow]

From: Susan Lewis <susan.lewis@acmeretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark Hsu <mark.hsu@acmeretail.com>
Date: 2027-02-02T09:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Procurement route decision + SOC 2 / DPA evidence needed for Acme Retail

Thanks Marissa — quick answers from my side.

1) Procurement: Our default is PO, but for platform/tooling purchases the procurement team will consider marketplace if product/legal gives a clear SOW/price. Marketplace typically shortens the legal review by ~2 weeks.
2) SOC 2: We require a Type II report; our vendor portal prefers a PDF upload but will accept a secure link.
3) DPA: We have a few non-standard clauses around subprocessing and logging retention. Expect our legal team to redline.

Mark (cc) will confirm whether Finance will accept a marketplace purchase for this contract (Mark — can you confirm by EOD 2/3?).

Also: Can you share KMS/encryption-at-rest details and whether Redwood supports Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK)? That will help our security review.

Best,
Susan Lewis
Director, Platform Procurement
Acme Retail

From: Mark Hsu <mark.hsu@acmeretail.com>

Date: 2027-02-03T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Procurement route decision + SOC 2 / DPA evidence needed for Acme Retail

Marissa / Susan — quick update from Finance: they are willing to approve AWS Marketplace for this purchase if pricing is equivalent and we can get a 30-day invoice. PO route is fine too but will need a standard vendor onboarding packet (W9, insurance cert, SOC 2 upload). Marketplace reduces paperwork but may require a different billing cadence.

Two asks for Redwood:
- Provide a SOC 2 PDF we can upload to our vendor portal.
- Confirm whether Redwood can accept a PO with NET30 terms (vendor onboarding team will request a sample invoice).

If you can send the SOC 2 and a short commercial summary, I can escalate for internal sign-off and (hopefully) avoid a long legal negotiation on the DPA.

-Mark
